notes.iso27701: Numbering follows ISO/IEC 27701:2019. A later edition may restructure clauses; verify and bump the checklist version if you migrate.
notes.ccpa: ADMT rows carry effective_from 2027-01-01 and are reported as forward-looking until then. Verify CPPA regulation dates against cppa.ca.gov before relying on them.
notes.soc2: SOC 2 is an attestation of operating effectiveness. Rows marked public_disclosure_expected are scored from public notices only in 'penalize' mode and are reported as disclosure-only.
notes.scope: This checklist is a working audit aid, not legal advice. Have counsel review it before commercial use.

requirements.title: Controller identity and contact
requirements.looks_for: Names the controller (and EU representative if applicable) with contact details such as postal address, email or contact form.

requirements.title: Categories of personal data
requirements.looks_for: Lists the categories of personal data processed.

requirements.title: Data Protection Officer contact
requirements.looks_for: Gives DPO contact details (email or postal address).

requirements.title: Purposes and legal basis per purpose
requirements.looks_for: States each purpose (or purpose group) AND the Art 6 legal basis that applies to it.
requirements.partial: Lists purposes and lawful bases separately without mapping bases to purposes.

requirements.title: Legitimate interests identified
requirements.looks_for: Where legitimate interests are relied on, identifies the specific interests pursued.
requirements.partial: Names interests only generically.
requirements.na_when: The document does not rely on legitimate interests.

requirements.title: Recipients or categories of recipients
requirements.looks_for: Identifies recipients or categories of recipients of personal data.

requirements.title: Third-country transfers and safeguards
requirements.looks_for: Discloses transfers outside the EEA/UK, the safeguard relied on (adequacy, SCCs, BCRs, DPF) and how to obtain a copy.
requirements.partial: Names the mechanism but gives no way to obtain a copy.
requirements.na_when: The document states there are no transfers outside the EEA/UK.
requirements.must_match: standard contractual clauses|\bSCCs?\b|adequacy|binding corporate rules|data privacy framework|\bDPF\b|transfer mechanism|data transfer agreement|adequacy decision|cross[\s\-]border transfer

requirements.title: Retention period or criteria
requirements.looks_for: States the retention period, or the criteria used to determine it, ideally per data category.
requirements.partial: Generic criteria only (e.g., 'as long as necessary') with no periods or categories.

requirements.title: Data subject rights
requirements.looks_for: Lists access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, and how to exercise them.
requirements.partial: Some rights missing or no exercise mechanism.

requirements.title: Right to withdraw consent
requirements.looks_for: States the right to withdraw consent at any time and how.
requirements.na_when: No processing is based on consent.

requirements.title: Right to complain to a supervisory authority
requirements.looks_for: States the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
requirements.must_match: supervisory authorit|data protection authorit|information commissioner|\bICO\b|\bEDPB\b|lodge a complaint|right to complain

requirements.title: Statutory/contractual requirement to provide data
requirements.looks_for: States whether providing data is a statutory or contractual requirement and the consequences of not providing it.

requirements.title: Automated decision-making and profiling
requirements.looks_for: States whether automated decision-making or profiling with legal/similar effects exists, with meaningful information about the logic, or states that none exists (scoped to the EEA/UK).
requirements.partial: Statement exists but is scoped only to another jurisdiction or lacks logic/consequences.

requirements.title: Source of data not collected from the data subject
requirements.looks_for: States the source of data obtained indirectly, including publicly accessible sources.
requirements.na_when: All data is collected directly from the data subject.

requirements.title: Right to object presented clearly and separately
requirements.looks_for: Draws the right to object (including to direct marketing and legitimate-interest processing) to attention explicitly and separately.
requirements.partial: Right to object is listed among other rights without distinct presentation.

requirements.title: Special category data condition
requirements.looks_for: If special category data (ethnicity, health, religion, biometrics, etc.) is processed, states the Art 9(2) condition (e.g., explicit consent).
requirements.na_when: No special category data is collected or processed.

requirements.title: Concise, transparent, intelligible form
requirements.looks_for: Plain language with no unresolved cross-references, duplicated or contradictory sections.
requirements.partial: Mostly clear but contains duplicated sections, dangling references or contradictions.

requirements.title: Notice of changes
requirements.looks_for: Describes how changes to the notice are communicated and the notice period.

requirements.title: Subject-matter, duration, nature, purpose, data types, data subjects
requirements.looks_for: Specifies subject-matter, duration, nature and purpose of processing, types of personal data and categories of data subjects.

requirements.title: Processing only on documented instructions
requirements.looks_for: Processor acts only on documented controller instructions, including for transfers, unless required by law.

requirements.title: Confidentiality commitment
requirements.looks_for: Persons authorised to process are bound by confidentiality.

requirements.title: Security measures
requirements.looks_for: Processor implements Art 32 technical and organisational measures.

requirements.title: Sub-processor conditions
requirements.looks_for: Requires prior authorisation (specific or general with objection right) and flow-down of the same obligations to sub-processors, with processor liability.

requirements.title: Assistance with data subject requests
requirements.looks_for: Processor assists the controller to respond to data subject rights requests.

requirements.title: Assistance with security, breach notification and DPIAs
requirements.looks_for: Processor assists with Arts 32-36 and notifies the controller of a personal data breach without undue delay.
requirements.partial: Breach notification present without a timeframe or without assistance obligations.

requirements.title: Deletion or return at end of services
requirements.looks_for: At the controller's choice, deletes or returns all personal data at the end of services, and deletes copies.

requirements.title: Audit and information rights
requirements.looks_for: Processor makes available information to demonstrate compliance and allows audits/inspections.

requirements.title: Notice of infringing instructions
requirements.looks_for: Processor informs the controller if an instruction infringes data protection law.

requirements.title: Transfer mechanism in DPA
requirements.looks_for: Specifies the transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, BCRs, DPF) for any restricted transfers.
requirements.na_when: The DPA states no restricted transfers occur.

requirements.title: Pseudonymisation and encryption
requirements.looks_for: Describes encryption and/or pseudonymisation of personal data.

requirements.title: Confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience
requirements.looks_for: Describes ongoing measures for confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of systems.

requirements.title: Ability to restore availability
requirements.looks_for: Describes backup/restore or recovery capability after an incident.

requirements.title: Regular testing and evaluation
requirements.looks_for: Describes regular testing, assessment or evaluation of the effectiveness of security measures.

requirements.title: Breach detection and notification procedure
requirements.looks_for: Defines a breach detection/escalation procedure including notification to the controller or authority within 72 hours where applicable.

requirements.title: Storage limitation and disposal
requirements.looks_for: Defines retention periods or deletion triggers and secure disposal or return of personal data.

requirements.title: Categories of PI collected (last 12 months)
requirements.looks_for: Lists the categories of personal information collected in the preceding 12 months.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Categories of sources
requirements.looks_for: Lists categories of sources of personal information.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Business or commercial purposes
requirements.looks_for: States the business or commercial purposes for collecting, selling or sharing PI.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Categories disclosed for a business purpose and recipients
requirements.looks_for: Lists categories of PI disclosed for a business purpose AND the categories of recipients.
requirements.partial: Categories disclosed but recipients not mapped.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Categories sold or shared and third-party categories
requirements.looks_for: States categories of PI sold or shared and categories of third parties, or states that PI is not sold or shared.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Retention per category
requirements.looks_for: States how long each category is retained, or the criteria used to determine retention.
requirements.partial: Generic criteria only; not per category.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Sensitive personal information categories
requirements.looks_for: Identifies categories of sensitive PI collected and the purposes of use.
requirements.na_when: No sensitive personal information is collected.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Right to know
requirements.looks_for: Explains the right to know categories and specific pieces of PI and how to request.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Right to delete
requirements.looks_for: Explains the right to delete, exceptions, and that service providers are instructed to delete.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Right to correct
requirements.looks_for: Explains the right to correct inaccurate PI.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Right to opt out of sale/sharing
requirements.looks_for: Explains the right to opt out and provides a conspicuous link/method; or states clearly that PI is not sold or shared.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Right to limit use of sensitive PI
requirements.looks_for: Offers the right to limit, or states SPI is used only for permitted purposes.
requirements.na_when: No sensitive PI is collected or it is used only for permitted purposes.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Opt-out preference signal (GPC)
requirements.looks_for: States that opt-out preference signals such as GPC are honored.
requirements.na_when: The document states PI is neither sold nor shared.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Non-discrimination
requirements.looks_for: Commits not to discriminate against consumers exercising rights.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Request methods
requirements.looks_for: Provides methods to submit requests (two methods unless an online-only exemption applies).
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Authorized agent process
requirements.looks_for: Explains how an authorized agent can submit requests.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Verification process
requirements.looks_for: Explains how identity is verified before fulfilling requests.
requirements.partial: States verification may occur without explaining what is requested.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Response timing
requirements.looks_for: States 45-day response (+45 extension) and applies any two-per-12-month limit only to right-to-know requests.
requirements.partial: Timing present but request limit framed more broadly than the statute allows.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Date last updated
requirements.looks_for: Shows the date last updated and is reviewed at least every 12 months.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Minors under 16
requirements.looks_for: States PI of known consumers under 16 is not sold or shared without opt-in.
requirements.na_when: The document states no sale or sharing occurs.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Shine the Light
requirements.looks_for: Addresses disclosure to third parties for their direct marketing and a request method.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Notice at collection
requirements.looks_for: Notice at collection covers categories, purposes, whether sold/shared, retention and a link to the policy.
requirements.partial: Notice present but missing retention or sold/shared statements.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: ADMT pre-use notice and rights
requirements.looks_for: If ADMT is used for significant decisions: pre-use notice, opt-out and access rights are provided.
requirements.na_when: The document states ADMT is not used for significant decisions.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Specified limited business purposes
requirements.looks_for: Contract specifies the limited and specified business purposes for processing.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Prohibition on selling or sharing
requirements.looks_for: Prohibits the service provider from selling or sharing personal information.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Prohibition on retaining, using or disclosing outside the contract
requirements.looks_for: Prohibits retaining, using or disclosing PI for any purpose other than the specified business purposes or outside the direct business relationship.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Prohibition on combining PI
requirements.looks_for: Prohibits combining PI received with PI from other sources except as permitted.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: CCPA compliance and same level of protection
requirements.looks_for: Requires compliance with the CCPA and the same level of privacy protection as the business.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Business monitoring rights
requirements.looks_for: Grants the business rights to take reasonable steps to ensure use is consistent with its obligations (audits, assessments).
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Notice if unable to comply
requirements.looks_for: Requires notice to the business if the service provider can no longer meet its obligations.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Stop and remediate unauthorized use
requirements.looks_for: Gives the business the right to stop and remediate unauthorized use of PI.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Subcontractor flow-down
requirements.looks_for: Requires written contracts with subcontractors containing the same restrictions and notice to the business.
requirements.standard: CCPA/CPRA + CPPA regulations (11 CCR §7000 et seq.)

requirements.title: Logical access controls
requirements.looks_for: Describes logical access security: authentication, MFA, role-based access and least privilege.

requirements.title: Provisioning and de-provisioning
requirements.looks_for: Describes user access provisioning, periodic review and prompt revocation on termination.

requirements.title: Role-based access and segregation of duties
requirements.looks_for: Describes role-based access, least privilege and segregation of duties.

requirements.title: Boundary protection
requirements.looks_for: Describes firewalls, network segmentation or intrusion detection protecting system boundaries.

requirements.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
requirements.looks_for: Describes encryption of data in transit (e.g., TLS 1.2+) and at rest (e.g., AES-256).
requirements.partial: Only one of in-transit/at-rest, or no algorithms/standards named.

requirements.title: Vulnerability management
requirements.looks_for: Describes vulnerability scanning, patching and penetration testing.

requirements.title: Security monitoring and anomaly detection
requirements.looks_for: Describes monitoring of systems for anomalies and security events, including logging.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.looks_for: Describes documented incident response: triage, containment, escalation, communication and post-incident review.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.looks_for: Describes authorised, tested and approved changes before production.

requirements.title: Backups and recovery
requirements.looks_for: Describes scheduled backups, resilience and recovery capabilities (RTO/RPO).

requirements.title: Recovery testing
requirements.looks_for: Describes periodic testing of recovery procedures.

requirements.title: Vendor and subprocessor risk management
requirements.looks_for: Describes vendor due diligence, contractual security requirements and ongoing monitoring.
requirements.partial: Vendors contractually bound but no due diligence or monitoring described.

requirements.title: Retention and secure disposal
requirements.looks_for: Describes retention limits and secure disposal of personal information.

requirements.title: Reference to independent attestation
requirements.looks_for: References an independent SOC 2 (or equivalent) attestation or report availability.

requirements.title: Identify and document purpose
requirements.looks_for: Documents the specific purposes of processing.

requirements.title: Identify lawful basis
requirements.looks_for: Identifies the lawful basis for processing.
requirements.partial: Bases named but not mapped to purposes.

requirements.title: Determine when and how consent is obtained
requirements.looks_for: States when consent is required and how it is obtained.

requirements.title: Contracts with PII processors
requirements.looks_for: States that processors are bound by contract on privacy/security.
requirements.partial: Contracts mentioned without terms.

requirements.title: Provide information to PII principals
requirements.looks_for: Provides clear and complete information about processing to PII principals.

requirements.title: Mechanism to modify or withdraw consent
requirements.looks_for: Provides a mechanism to modify or withdraw consent.

requirements.title: Mechanism to object
requirements.looks_for: Provides a mechanism to object to processing.
requirements.partial: Right listed but no dedicated mechanism.

requirements.title: Access, correction and erasure
requirements.looks_for: Provides means to access, correct and erase PII.

requirements.title: Inform third parties of changes
requirements.looks_for: Informs third parties of modification, withdrawal or erasure.
requirements.partial: Only service providers informed.

requirements.title: Provide copy of PII processed
requirements.looks_for: Provides a copy of PII processed on request.

requirements.title: Handling requests
requirements.looks_for: Defines handling of PII principal requests, including timelines.
requirements.partial: Timelines for some jurisdictions only.

requirements.title: Automated decision-making
requirements.looks_for: Addresses automated decision-making obligations.
requirements.partial: Scoped to one jurisdiction only.

requirements.title: Limit collection
requirements.looks_for: Limits PII collection to what is necessary.

requirements.title: De-identification and deletion at end of processing
requirements.looks_for: States PII is deleted or de-identified when no longer needed.
requirements.partial: Only 'where feasible'.

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.looks_for: Defines PII retention periods or schedule.
requirements.partial: Generic criteria only.

requirements.title: Basis for transfer between jurisdictions
requirements.looks_for: Identifies the basis for international PII transfers.

requirements.title: Countries to which PII is transferred
requirements.looks_for: Identifies the countries or organizations PII may be transferred to.
requirements.partial: Region/'other countries' only.

requirements.title: Records of PII disclosure to third parties
requirements.looks_for: Identifies third parties/categories to which PII is disclosed (e.g., a subprocessor list).
requirements.partial: Categories only.

requirements.title: Customer agreement
requirements.looks_for: Agreement addresses processor obligations towards the customer.

requirements.title: Organization's purposes
requirements.looks_for: Processing only for the customer's documented purposes; no independent use.

requirements.title: Infringing instruction
requirements.looks_for: Processor informs customer if an instruction infringes law.

requirements.title: Obligations to PII principals
requirements.looks_for: Processor assists customer with PII principal obligations.

requirements.title: Return, transfer or disposal of PII
requirements.looks_for: Defines return, transfer or secure disposal of PII at end of services.

requirements.title: Basis for PII transfer between jurisdictions
requirements.looks_for: Identifies the basis for international transfers.

requirements.title: Notification of PII disclosure requests
requirements.looks_for: Processor notifies the customer of disclosure requests from authorities.

requirements.title: Legally binding PII disclosures
requirements.looks_for: Addresses legally binding disclosures and customer notice where permitted.

requirements.title: Disclosure of subcontractors used
requirements.looks_for: Discloses subcontractors used to process PII.

requirements.title: Engagement of a subcontractor
requirements.looks_for: Requires customer authorisation/contract terms before engaging a subcontractor.

requirements.title: Change of subcontractor
requirements.looks_for: Notifies the customer of subcontractor changes with a chance to object.

requirements.title: Role determination and PIMS scope
requirements.looks_for: Determines whether the organization acts as PII controller and/or processor and defines privacy governance scope.

requirements.title: Temporary files
requirements.looks_for: Defines deletion or sanitization of temporary files created during processing.

requirements.title: Disposal
requirements.looks_for: Defines secure disposal procedures for PII and media.

requirements.title: PII transmission controls
requirements.looks_for: Protects PII transmitted over public networks (e.g., encryption).

requirements.title: Logging and audit trails (via ISO/IEC 27002)
requirements.looks_for: Logs access to and changes of PII with protected audit trails.
